name: Burlington (United States)
description: Five horizontal zigzag stripes of blue, white, green, white and blue, for Lake Champlain, the mountains and the city's green.
history: Burlington is the largest city in Vermont, on Lake Champlain. The flag, submission #83 in a public contest, was designed by Owen and Lucas Marchessault and adopted by the city council on 27 November 2017 during the mayoralty of Miro Weinberger; the council resolved that the design be freely available for public use.
